title: Registration
password-rules:
Please note that the password must contain:

  • 8 or more characters
  • uppercase and lowercase Latin letters
  • special characters (! " # $ % & ' ( ) * + , - . / : ; < = > ? @ [ ] ^ _` { | } ~)
  • numbers
click-log-in: You have successfully registered in the system! Click “Log in” to proceed to authorization
